usedFor: Thoughtly keeps contacts and phones them, where “Create Contact” adds one and “Call Contact” starts a call.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order Created” in Lemon Squeezy, then “Create Contact” in Thoughtly
bestTemplate.why: A new order brings a customer, and the action adds them as a contact ready to call.

watchOut: “Call Contact” reaches someone outside your team, so it waits in Needs you for your approval.
